item.title: Saudi Official Warns Patience Is Limited as Iranian Attacks Barrage Kingdom
item.summary: Prince Faisal bin Farhan, the foreign minister, said Saudi Arabia was prepared to take military action if necessary, after waves of missile and drone attacks.

item.title: Trump Says U.S. and Qatar Not Involved in Strike on Iran’s South Pars Gas Field
item.summary: President Trump said Israel was responsible for the attack, but vowed to “massively” destroy the gas field if Tehran hit Qatar’s energy facilities in retaliation.

item.title: Iranian Missile Attack Leaves 3 Palestinians Dead in West Bank
item.summary: Several others were injured in the strike, which hit a caravan being used as a hair salon in the town of Beit Awwa, according to Palestinian officials.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Wednesday
item.summary: A day of strikes on energy facilities and testimony in Washington to members of Congress.

item.title: Iran Turns Out for Funeral for Those Killed in Strikes
item.summary: Some died in Iran, others on a sea far from home. They were honored together Wednesday at a procession in Tehran.

item.title: Days of Anger and Fear for Iranians Living With Waves of Airstrikes
item.summary: Residents in Tehran and elsewhere say the attacks come at all hours and rock the ground.

item.title: For Iranians, Bombing of Gas Field Worsens Already Dire Energy Crisis
item.summary: The South Pars gas field, hit by airstrikes on Wednesday, is central to the energy supply of Iran, which was already suffering blackouts before the war.

item.title: Palestinian Man Recounts Brutal Sexual Assault by Israeli Settlers
item.summary: The man said his attackers stripped him naked, beat him and zip-tied his genitalia, an account corroborated by family members and a rights activist who were also beaten.

item.title: Strikes Deliver Another Blow to Iran’s Domestic Energy Sites
item.summary: The attacks could worsen the severe electricity shortages that Iranians already face.

item.title: Iran Maintains Near-Total Internet Blackout Amid U.S.-Israeli Strikes
item.summary: As the war has stretched into its third week, the Iranian government has blocked internet access for most of its 92 million citizens.
